attributes.title: Autonomous SOC Command Center
attributes.description: Real-time monitoring of the autonomous SOC simulation — pipeline metrics, agent health, confidence distribution, evolution tracking.
attributes.panelsJSON:
[{"gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 48, "h": 15, "i": "welcome"}, "panelIndex": "welcome", "embeddableConfig": {"savedVis": {"title": "SOC Overview", "description": "", "type": "markdown", "params": {"markdown": "# Autonomous SOC Command Center

**Pipeline:** Alert → Triage → Enrichment → Hunt → Response → Case

**Scheduled Agents:** DetEng (30m) | Watchdog (5m) | Meta (15m) | Difficulty Controller (5m) | Recovery (10m)

**Data Views:** Use the SOC Pipeline, SOC Audit Trail, SOC Agent Health, SOC Evolution, and SOC Attack Commands data views to explore data.

**ES|QL queries to try:**
- MTTD: `FROM .soc-outcomes | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 30 MINUTES | STATS avg_mttd = AVG(time_to_detect)`
- MTTR: `FROM .soc-outcomes | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 30 MINUTES | STATS avg_mttr = AVG(time_to_respond)`
- Throughput: `FROM .soc-audit-trail | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 1 HOUR | STATS count = COUNT(*)`
- Agent Health: `FROM .soc-agent-health | STATS throughput = LAST(throughput), status = LAST(status) BY agent_id`
- Difficulty: `FROM .soc-difficulty-state | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 1 | KEEP level, level_name`
- Dead Letters: `FROM .soc-dead-letter | WHERE retry_count < 3 | STATS count = COUNT(*)`

**Tip:** Create Lens visualizations from these data views and add them to this dashboard.", "fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": false}, "uiState": {}}}, "type": "visualization"}]
